summary:
w177 planned: r20, r21, r4, r5, r12 go green; three deprecated scenarios (r4, r5, r12) are removed per Retires.
Decisions: new commands `work ask <request> <line> <question>` and `work reply <request> <n> <answer>` (0067: each part its own command); `work answer` stays the work-item command.
Questions are numbered in asking order, each naming its line; the n-th answer answers the n-th (Implementation r20/r21).
Ask is refused in the asker's turn, reply in the upstream's (r16); both commit through _change (r12); asking does not write the line outcome (0067, r5).
Tests broken: none (verified by search and notes section 4).
File set: the researcher's five plus CLAUDE.md's module-map row.
Open cases: question on a missing line, reply to a missing or answered question, empty texts, the supervise_intake question route, defects D1-D5.
